articles.title: Strategy buys 535 bitcoin for $43 million days after signaling potential BTC sales
articles.snippet: Last week's purchases were funded by sales of the company's common stock.

articles.title: Michael Saylor’s latest tax strategy echoes Strategy’s 2022 bitcoin sale
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor confirmed the company was prepared to sell bitcoin, reviving a tax loss harvesting strategy first used in 2022.

articles.title: DAPPOS launches xBubble: An AI agent that learns and uses AI for you
articles.snippet: xBubble allows users to complete specific tasks with simpler prompts by automatically building and dispatching task-specific AI agents.

articles.title: Crypto.com receives UAE license for Dubai government crypto payments
articles.snippet: Crypto.com says a new UAE Stored Value Facilities license will let residents pay Dubai government fees in crypto, as the company doubles down on regulated expansion in the Middle East and beyond.

articles.title: Keel Infrastructure Posts $145 Million Loss as Firm Completes Pivot From Bitcoin Miner to AI
articles.snippet: Formerly known as Bitfarms, the newly rebranded Keel touted a $533 million war chest to fund AI infrastructure buildout.
